competition_baseline.away: mean away-team goals in prior same-competition FINISHED fixtures
competition_baseline.historical_normalization: Use baseline available before each historical appearance; never backfill later means.
competition_baseline.home: mean home-team goals in prior same-competition FINISHED fixtures
competition_baseline.update_policy: Expanding point-in-time mean, applied after each UTC date batch.

elo.scope: Separate competition pools; FINISHED fixtures only.

missing_values.dataset: Preserve undefined historical features as empty CSV cells/null values.
missing_values.model_preprocessing: Fit numeric medians, missing indicators, scaling and categorical encoders on each training fold only.

recent_form.partial_window: Average over available observations; missing only when none exist.
recent_form.scope: Prior same-competition FINISHED appearances across venues and seasons.

configuration.same_date_policy: All fixtures on one UTC date are featurized before any result from that date updates state.

team_strength.scope: Same competition, all prior venues, FINISHED fixtures only.
